means: For every scored T-spin in the corpus (a T with an engine spin credit that cleared lines, inside the verified prefix, passing the reconstruction check), whether the 欄干 (Parapet) page's local shape stood around it: the lock's cells are the page's T (variant parapet: laid flat, pointing down, at a full TSD; variant parapet_tss: stood up, nub right, at a full TSS; as drawn, or mirrored) and every cell of the window around it — the L's stem, the slot and the roof in the row above the TSD's, the two rows the TSD clears with the L's foot under the T's arm, and the well two rows deep under it — is filled or empty as drawn. Every hit is followed to the first later piece that enters the well's column, to see whether it is the Tetris the page sets up.
not_eligible_because: simulator output: which local shape a T went into is read off the vendored Triangle engine's boards, and nothing on the corpus side has a second implementation of it. No claim id, no badge, no figure in a report.
caveat: garbage is read as FILLED inside the window, and its hole columns are the engine's seeded-RNG columns, which disagree with the recorded ones (oracle-source.ts): the well cells under the T's arm can be garbage rows' holes, so a hit's well is the board the oracle offered, and a hit with garbage in its window is named in garbage_in_window for that reason. At a full TSD the two cleared rows are entailed by the clear (NaiveClauseForced), and so is the well re-opening inside the window: the payoff (an I clearing 4 into the well, inside the verified prefix, whose attack the replay recorded) is what the window does not decide. Counts only, always N / M with the denominator.
rules: opportunity, per variant: the full T-spin its transcription names (parapet: a TSD clearing 2 lines; parapet_tss: a TSS clearing 1), at a 0-based lock index <= the verified index, whose board-before plus its cells makes exactly the rows the engine recorded clearing (the reconstruction check, counted exactly as opener-facts.json donation.check counts it)

match: the lock's cells equal the variant's T under one translation (mirrored: columns reflected in the window), and every other window cell is filled (a piece or garbage) or empty as the page draws it; colour is never compared; cells outside the window are not read
mirrored is tried only when as-drawn fails; a window leaving the board is no match (window_off_board, each entry naming its variant)

payoff: the well cell under the T's left arm (mirrored: right) carried through every clear and garbage insertion, each step verified against the engine's next board, to the first later lock with a cell in its column; fired iff that lock is inside the verified prefix, has a cell at or below the carried cell, is an I and cleared 4 lines (otherwise past_verified, well_covered, well_filled_not_i, i_in_well_not_quad, rowmap_unverified, slot_off_board or round_ended); well_depth = the empty cells under the well cell on the board before the spin, garbage filled

controls, per variant: the same window at the profile's other scored spins (under parapet_tss the TSD is one of them); ablations no_must_empty, no_roof and t_overlap at the variant's opportunity; orientation_baseline = opportunities whose T stands up
window_rule: 0-based lock index <= 21 is in_opener (emit-opener-facts.ts's convention; emit-attack-facts.ts counts from 1)

rules: fragment: a cell both of the page's builds (basic.z, basic.o) draw as a piece of their own inside the window (the stood L and the two roof cells, mirrored with the window) belongs to a piece not all four of whose cells are on the board before the T (a line clear cut it)
garbage_in_shape: one of those cells is garbage
shape_cell_empty: one of those cells is empty (the window requires it filled, so only a weakened window can admit this)
l_not_one_piece: the four cells the page draws as its L are not one piece (the page: 「%Lを1列ずらして立てて置き」)
dpc: the board is empty after one of the 14 locks before the T, the T itself, or one of the 14 after it (the DPC setup)
ownership_unverified: a lock before the T has a row map the digest could not verify, so its pieces cannot be told apart
qualifies iff none applies; the shape stood at every hit either way
